name: Dragon-Rider Bond
laws: Bond is established when rider touches hatched dragon's egg and it chooses them
Mind-link is involuntary; emotions bleed across
Rider gains extended life, pointed ears, increased strength; dragon grows into full telepathic intelligence
Death of one devastates the other
costs: Rider's magic depends on emotional state of both parties
limits: Cannot access full capability without the dragon's cooperation
Bond can be corrupted by force (Galbatorix)

name: Ancient Language Magic
laws: Cannot lie in the Ancient Language
Energy drawn from magician's own body; can be supplemented from Eldunarí or allies
costs: Can kill the magician if overreached
Knowledge of true names is rare and guarded
limits: Limited by the structural constraints of the spell's wording
examples: The wardings placed on Eragon by the Elves
